slogan: Show it once. Keep how it works.

type.text_style: Sentence case; direct, concrete and short.

layout.reframe_policy: Preserve the full interaction unless an explicitly labelled editorial crop is selected.

motion.logo_motion: Subtle fade and scale from 94% to 100%.
motion.scene_rhythm: Show actual product evidence within three seconds; hold readable proof for three to five seconds.

audio.direction: Instrumental minimal electronic pulse, clean and understated; no vocals.
audio.pixabay_policy: Use locally imported audio with saved track page, contributor and licence acknowledgement. Preserve any Content ID/certificate information. Never claim a guaranteed claim-free licence.

narrative: Reveal segmentation or separate native parts.
Show the library, agent handoff or robot task.

copy.voice: Precise, curious, professional. Show the capability before describing the architecture.

evidence_rules: Only use declared, hash-verified project media.
Do not describe an existing example as a new release unless its release status supports that statement.
Label authored robot staging and position cues; do not claim physical grasp, contact or robot learning.
SAM masks are observed model outputs; generated geometry and motion remain estimates.
Saved preferences guide editing, never change the underlying evidence or approval status.
Approval enables a downloadable marketing package, not automatic social publication.
